title: A French Lens Podcast
author: Stories of building a new life in France — from Americans abroad to the French entrepreneurs welcoming travelers to the Loire Valley.
description: A French Lens is part memoir, part conversation — Abbie and Jeff's own story of building a new life in France, paired with honest interviews with others who have made the leap and the French business owners shaping what it means to truly experience this country. afrenchlens.substack.com
